title: In 2024, Glenn and Barbara Britt gave Dartmouth College $150 M, easing tuition costs for families
summary_full: In 2024, Dartmouth College announced a scholarship bequest of more than $150 million from former Time Warner Cable CEO Glenn Britt and his wife, Barbara Britt. The gift raised the annual family income threshold for zero parent contribution from $65,000 to $125,000, benefiting around 350 families each year. It also expanded scholarship support at Dartmouth's Tuck School of Business.
